q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of viscose fabric?
title: Viscose fabric carbon footprint per metre
short: Start with the viscose yarn per metre of fabric and the fibre and spinning suppliers' figures. Add weaving or knitting and wet processing energy, especially steam for dyeing and finishing, then divide by metres produced.

ul: Viscose staple fibre or filament yarn.
Scouring, dyeing or printing, usually steam heated.

p: Report per metre by width and weight per square metre. Fibre and wet processing usually make up most of the figure.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per metre (one month)
lines: Plant total: 115,200 / 200,000 = 0.576 kg CO2 per metre
Add viscose yarn and dyes for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
